model_annotation: The image displays two separate line plots comparing the training rewards over steps for two different algorithms, Llama-On-Policy and Llama-LUFFY, under two distinct training conditions: “Easy Training Set” and “Hard Training Set.” Both plots share the same axes: the x-axis, labeled “Steps,” ranges from 0 to 500 with tick marks at intervals of 100; the y-axis, labeled “Training Rewards,” ranges from 0.0 to 0.4 (in the top plot) or 0.0 to 0.2 (in the bottom plot), with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. In the top plot, the “Llama-On-Policy-Easy” algorithm is represented by a teal line with circle markers and a solid line, starting near 0.0 and rising to approximately 0.4 by step 500, showing fluctuations around 0.35–0.40 after step 200. The “Llama-LUFFY-Easy” algorithm is represented by a red line with triangle markers and a solid line, starting near 0.0 and rising to approximately 0.4 by step 500, with a similar fluctuating pattern around 0.35–0.40 after step 200. In the bottom plot, the “Llama-On-Policy-Hard” algorithm is represented by a teal line with circle markers and a solid line, starting near 0.0 and declining sharply to near 0.0 by step 200, remaining near 0.0 thereafter. The “Llama-LUFFY-Hard” algorithm is represented by a red line with triangle markers and a solid line, starting near 0.0 and rising to approximately 0.2 by step 500, with fluctuations around 0.1–0.2 after step 200.
